comment: The section assumes that legal basis, consent, data-sharing agreements, and governance can be established coherently across all exchanging organisations. In fragmented or decentralised settings, these arrangements may be incomplete or inconsistent.

anchor.note: p.72 l.Lines 737-742 read as the printed page; section 3.6 agrees

public.text: The section assumes that legal basis, consent, data-sharing agreements, and governance can be established coherently across all exchanging organisations. In fragmented or decentralised settings, these arrangements may be incomplete or inconsistent.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a staged pathway allowing countries to begin with bounded use cases, defined participants, limited datasets, explicit legal authority, and controlled exchange agreements before scaling nationally.
